qualifier: Root, AI-assisted source/saved-result review; not blind or independent native reproduction
scope: Only the frozen five IPv4 inputs and four integer-hook configurations; no all-input or unseen-source guarantee.
input_revision: v3, source and observation informed before first scoring/projecting/fitting of these texts
label_policy: Positive requires every frozen input satisfied and zero unknown. Negative is a witnessed finite-contract mismatch with complete scoped caption evidence. Unsupported, malformed or incomplete evidence remains unknown; diagnostics are excluded.
weight_policy: One eligible candidate has unit BCE sample weight. Repeated vectors do not multiply parent or candidate weight. Pair policy must be bound in a later projection recipe; no pairs are fabricated here.
group_policy: Cobra/pflag whole source component77; mapstructure component78. Existing actual79 components remain unchanged. Catalog links and shared source/fork/alias/template links remain within components. Mechanism similarity alone is not contract equivalence. Actual cross-role collisions block the affected fit without role moves or seed search.
feature_policy: Only request and candidate text. Identifiers, outcomes, source/group/role, Want/Got, weights and hashes are excluded. API names are identifiers, absent from the text.

parents.request: For frozen IPv4 strings, trim CIDRs into masked networks. Preserve the previous network on errors and reject bare addresses.

candidates.caption: On frozen inputs, trim CIDRs into masked networks; preserve the previous network on errors and reject bare addresses.
On frozen inputs, parse trimmed plain IP text; preserve the previous IP on errors, reject CIDRs, and accept bare addresses as IP values.
On frozen inputs, parse dotted IPv4 text into mask bytes; preserve the previous mask on errors, reject CIDRs, and accept bare addresses as masks.

parents.request: For frozen integer hooks, retry unchanged input until nil error, including nil output. Concatenate each failed message followed by a line feed; zero hooks must return an error.

candidates.caption: Try frozen hooks on unchanged input; stop on nil error, including nil output. If none succeed, return an error concatenating each message followed by a line feed.
Chain frozen hooks, passing each output onward; stop on the first error. With no hooks, return the original input without error.
